# asks

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:asks`](gmeow-asks.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/asks>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inquiry`](../../slices/inquiry.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent poses / holds a question as open — the base inquiry attitude and the cheap 80% surface. Range is intentionally OPEN: the object may be a [`gmeow:Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md) or a reified inquiry (the five-minute-gate shortcut, [Principle 13](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-13)). Non-functional — an agent holds many open questions at once. From whose vantage and over what period the question is held ride [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) and [`gmeow:validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`gmeow:validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md) on the statement, or a reified [`gmeow:InquiryTenure`](../classes/gmeow-InquiryTenure.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) -> `?`

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:asks`](gmeow-asks.md) from [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record that an agent poses or holds a question as open — the base inquiry attitude and the cheap 80% surface; the natural store_question companion of the epistemics store_claim spine.

### Avoid when

- Avoid reading it as a settled state — the question stays open until the agent [`gmeow:accepts`](gmeow-accepts.md) / [`gmeow:knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) an answer-claim (the epistemics spine, never a new resolved term) — and never make it functional; an agent holds many open questions.

### How to use

- Point the agent at a [`gmeow:Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md) or reified inquiry; carry the vantage and period on [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) / [`gmeow:validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`gmeow:validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md) of the statement, promote to [`gmeow:InquiryTenure`](../classes/gmeow-InquiryTenure.md) when the opening / closing is itself the fact, and mark resolution by an [`gmeow:accepts`](gmeow-accepts.md) / [`gmeow:knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) over an gmeow:answers-claim.

### Scope notes

- A question is OPEN for the agent until the agent [`gmeow:accepts`](gmeow-accepts.md) / [`gmeow:knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) an gmeow:answers-claim for it; resolution REUSES the epistemics spine, so there is no new 'resolved' term ([Principle 6](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-6)). Reopening closes the prior accepted answer with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)), never deletion.
